test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Drink a mixture of wormwood oil and olive oil __to got rid of__ worms.
solution:
The correct answer is: **to get rid of**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Option 4 is correct because it uses the correct phrasal verb ""get rid of"" to convey the intended meaning of eliminating worms. 
 
• Option 2 is incorrect because ""to rid off"" is not a correct phrasal verb. The correct form is ""to get rid of.""
 
• Option 3 is incorrect because it uses the incorrect preposition ""by"" after ""getting rid."" The correct preposition to use with ""getting rid"" is ""of."" Additionally, the use of the gerund ""getting"" is unnecessary and awkward in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **to get rid of**.
